000317: // Punctuator sets the frontend asks about repeatedly (see c_punctuator_in_set
000318: // in c.h). The parenthesis pair is what the two backward scans that look for
000319: // a control-statement head classify on; the statement-boundary set is the
000320: // punctuators that can precede a labelled statement without further proof.
000321: #define C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_PARENTHESES (C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
000322: #define C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_STATEMENT_BOUNDARY                                                                                                    \
000323:     (C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_SEMICOLON))
000324: // The three nesting pairs a declarator scan tracks, split by side. Each side
000325: // is three ids that are not adjacent in the enum — the pairs interleave — so
000326: // a compare chain over one side does not fold into a range test the way the
000327: // unary-operator chains do; these are the sets worth spelling as sets.
000328: // Digraph spellings carry distinct ids and are absent here, exactly as the
000329: // chains these replaced were written.
000330: #define C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_DELIMITER_OPEN                                                                                                        \
000331:     (C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
000332: #define C_PUNCTUATOR_SET_DELIMITER_CLOSE                                                                                                       \
000333:     (C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS) | C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET) |                                         \
000334:      C_PUNCTUATOR_BIT(C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
000335: BUSTER_C_EXTERN u16 c_token_length_field(u64 length);

000377: struct CSymbolTable
000378: {
000379:     Arena* arena;
000380:     String8* names;
000381:     CSymbolSlot* slots;
000382:     u8* builtin_kinds;
000383:     u8* class_bits;
000384:     // Specifier-word facts per predefined id (C_WORD_* in c_parse.c), the
000385:     // same dense shape as class_bits: every spelling any of the specifier
000386:     // predicates can accept is interned into the predefined range at create
000387:     // time, so `symbol > predefined_limit` is a constant-time "no" and the
000388:     // id-keyed load replaces the spelling ladders for interned tokens.
000389:     u16* word_bits;
000390:     u32 predefined_limit;
000391:     u32 slot_capacity;
000392:     u32 name_capacity;
000393:     u32 count;
000394: };
000395: 
000396: // The names a pass compares an identifier token against by hand, and their
000397: // interned ids. c_symbol_table_create interns this list first and in order,
000398: // so an enumerator *is* the id its spelling was assigned: a comparison is
000399: // `token.symbol == C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_FOR`, one immediate compare against a
000400: // field the token already carries, in place of materializing the spelling
000401: // through c_token_length's oversized guard and running string_equal.
000402: // C_SYMBOL_WELL_KNOWN_NONE is 0 so it coincides with the uninterned marker,
000403: // and the create-time BUSTER_CHECK holds the enum and the table together.
